steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Notes Master' and package identifier 'com.notesmaster.app'.

steps.title: Configure Multi-Project settings.gradle
steps.description: Establish workspace structure by defining the base application module location.

steps.title: Setup Project Root build.gradle
steps.description: Configure the top-level repository resolution and declare Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 dependencies.

steps.title: Configure App Build Parameters
steps.description: Establish the compilation dependencies, target SDK, and Java 8 support settings in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and System Themes
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml under correct namespace referencing launcher MainActivity and Material Theme.

steps.title: Create Modern Card and Capsule Drawables
steps.description: Define layout backgrounds, active/inactive category chip styles, input borders, and badge shapes.

steps.title: Design Application Layout
steps.description: Build layout including search bar, horizontal category scroll selector, lists, and empty state widgets.

steps.title: Create Interactive Note Dialog Layout
steps.description: Design modular dialog layout for entering note details, selecting categories, and saving content.

steps.title: Create List Row Item Layout
steps.description: Design custom row layout displaying card styling, timestamp, category badge, and control buttons.

steps.title: Configure App Strings
steps.description: Establish app names and string values within localized resource files.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Engine
steps.description: Implement DatabaseHelper class in Java for full notes CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) with SQLite.

steps.title: Implement Model Data Structures
steps.description: Define the Note model class to hold structural attributes of the notes.

steps.title: Implement App Logic and Dialog Integrations
steps.description: Develop main application logic including listing, filtering by category, filtering by search query, dialog setups, and CRUD listeners.

steps.title: Building Notes Master
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build Notes Master application using Gradle.
